title: review follow-ups of PR #37927: ci.yml ui filter misses docs/adr/0084, which studioMenuPlacement.test.ts reads
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① L1/L2 follow-ups of one PR (`review follow-ups of PR #N`, one card per PR, later rounds append here). Source: fleet (contract review of PR #37927, comment 7217478459, observation outside the diff; L1 7217675946).
Grading: area:devpath · Task · p2 · domain:devx. Same class as #27673 and #27717 (a diff confined to a file a ui job reads starts no ui job).
Reader: whichever seat holds area:devpath; not repo:objectstack#3 (no devpath intake).
Dedupe: `"PR #37927"` 2 hits (#37685, #37920, neither about CI); `studioMenuPlacement` 17 hits, none about the CI filter.

Business reason: ADR-0084's type → group table is pinned to the Studio menu code by `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`, so a wrong table row is caught before Studio's menu and its design record drift apart. A PR that edits only that ADR runs no ui job, so the pin test does not run on it: the PR shows green, merges, and the next ui PR goes red on a change it did not make. The person who pays is the next author, who has to find someone else's ADR edit.

## Items
- [ ] F1: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `ui` paths filter (origin/main, the `ui:` list near line 735) holds `ui/**` and the build roots but no `docs/adr/**`. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts:104` reads `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`. Other ui tests also read under `docs/adr/` (`product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-*.test.ts`, `check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts`, `select-type-check-scope.test.ts`); measure which of them a docs/adr-only diff can turn red. Expected: a diff confined to a docs/adr file one of these tests reads starts the ui job that runs it (on the PR and in the merge group). Pin it the way #27673 did (the filter-parity gate). Not measured yet: whether the merge group runs the ui jobs for such a diff.
